cues.text: Hello?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Oh, hello. Is that Julie Davison?
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: This is Greg Preston from the Employment Agency. We met last week when you came in to enquire about office work.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Oh, that's right.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Now we've just had some details come in of a job which might interest you.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: So this is a position for a receptionist – I believe you've done that sort of work before?
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Yes, I have, I worked in a sports centre for a couple of years before I got married and had the children.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Right. Well, this job's in Fordham, so not too far away for you, and it's at the medical centre there.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: OK. So where exactly is that?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: It's quite near the station, on Chastons Road.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Sorry?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Chastons Road – that's C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: OK, thanks. So what would the work involve? Dealing with enquiries from patients?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Yes, and you'd also be involved in making appointments, whether face to face or on the phone. And rescheduling them if necessary.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Fine, that shouldn't be a problem.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: And another of your duties would be keeping the centre's database up-to-date. Then you might have other general administrative duties as well, but those would be the main ones.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Now when the details came in, I immediately thought of you because one thing they do require is someone with experience, and you did mention your work at the sports centre when you came in to see us.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Yes, in fact I enjoyed that job. Is there anything else they're looking for?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Well, they say it's quite a high-pressure environment, they're always very busy, and patients are often under stress, so they want someone who can cope with that and stay calm, and at the same time be confident when interacting with the public.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Well, after dealing with three children all under five, I reckon I can cope with that.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: I'm sure you can.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: And then another thing they mention is that they're looking for someone with good IT skills...
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Not a problem.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: So you'd be interested in following this up?
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Sure. When would it start?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Well, they're looking for someone from the beginning of next month, but I should tell you that this isn't a permanent job, it's temporary, so the contract would be just to the end of September. But they do say that there could be further opportunities after that.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: OK. And what would the hours be?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Well, they want someone who can start at a quarter to eight in the morning – could you manage that?
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Yes, my husband would have to get the kids up and off to my mother's – she's going to be looking after them while I'm at work. What time would I finish?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: One fifteen.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: That should work out all right. I can pick the kids up on my way home, and then I'll have the afternoon with them. Oh, one thing... is there parking available for staff at the centre?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Yes, there is, and it's also on a bus route.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Right. Well, I expect I'll have the car but it's good to know that. OK, so where do I go from here?
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: Well, if you're happy for me to do so, I'll forward your CV and references, and then the best thing would probably be for you to phone them so they can arrange for an interview.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Great. Well thank you very much.
cues.speaker: JULIE

cues.text: You're welcome. Bye now.
cues.speaker: GREG

cues.text: Bye.
cues.speaker: JULIE
